mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, g.code AS gift_material_code, g.name AS gift_material_name, COALESCE(u.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(u.discount_total, 0) AS discount_total, COALESCE(u.gift_total, 0) AS gift_total FROM scm_promotion p LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_material g ON g.id = p.gift_material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT promotion_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_total, SUM(gift_qty) AS gift_total FROM scm_promotion_usage GROUP BY promotion_id ) u ON u.promotion_id = p.id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM scm_promotion WHERE status = 1 AND end_date >= #{date} AND begin_date <= #{date} AND (customer_level IS NULL OR customer_level = #{customerLevel}) ORDER BY id

SELECT u.order_id AS "orderId", o.order_no AS "orderNo", c.name AS "customerName", o.order_date AS "orderDate", o.status AS "status", u.discount_amount AS "discountAmount", u.gift_qty AS "giftQty" FROM scm_promotion_usage u JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = u.order_id LEFT JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = o.partner_id WHERE u.promotion_id = #{promotionId} ORDER BY u.order_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_promotion_usage (promotion_id, order_id, discount_amount, gift_qty, create_time) VALUES (#{u.promotionId}, #{orderId}, #{u.discountAmount}, #{u.giftQty}, NOW())
